verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Data, Privacy & Cybersecurity practice page claims top-ranked status and staff with former-federal-prosecutor backgrounds, implying incident/regulatory experience, but the evidence pack contains no explicit description of breach-response services, incident-response workflows, or regulator-facing work (e.g., FTC/state AG breach notifications) documented on the firm's pages. missing for 10: explicit breach-response service description, regulator-facing work details, case examples or dedicated incident-response page.
